Quote states each subnet must be associated with a NACL, new subnets get the default NACL, and the default NACL allows all inbound and outbound traffic.
Quote states IPv4 and IPv6 traffic are evaluated separately and no IPv4 rule applies to IPv6 traffic.

Quote states prefix lists cannot be referenced in NACL rules but the service IP ranges can be taken from its prefix list.

Quote gives January 31, 2023, public and private NAT gateways, and more ports raising the concurrent connection limit.
